1959 W. Cortland Street (“Subject Property”)
Type I Zoning Map Amendment

Narrative and Plans

The Applicant, Pitch Sweetwater LLC, is proposing a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment from a
B3-2, Community Shopping District to a B3-3, Community Shopping District. The Subject
Property is improved with a 3-story, mixed-use commercial and residential brick building.

The Applicant proposes to renovate and construct a 4" floor addition to the Subject Property to
expand the 3" floor dwelling unit. The Applicant will also seek a Variation to reduce the rear
setback from 30 feet to 0 feet in order to allow a second egress from the 3 and 4" floors to be
enclosed.

Proposed Zoning: B3-2, Community Shopping District to a B3-3,
Community Shopping District
1) Floor Area and Floor Area Ratio

a) Lot Area 3,136.25 Sq. Ft.
b) Total building area 9,408.75 Sq. Ft.
c) FAR 2.961
2) Density (minimum lot area per 1,045.41 Sq. Ft.
dwelling unit)
3) Amount of off-street parking 0
4) Setbacks Front: 0 Ft.
Side: 0 Ft. on South; 0 Ft. on North
Rear: 0 Ft.

5) Building height 52 Ft. 11 In.
